question:
You are helping Lina, who runs a manufacturing company near Casablanca. Here is what they told you, in their own order.
The company is choosing among 8 improvement projects, labelled P1 to P8.
Zineb, who manages the site, has 18 years of experience.
Around 74% of customers said they were satisfied in the last survey.
Each project is either done in full or not at all. Cost and expected yearly benefit:

| Project | Cost (dollars) | Yearly benefit (dollars) |
|---|---|---|
| P1 | 67,000 | 93,000 |
| P2 | 14,000 | 21,000 |
| P3 | 34,000 | 30,000 |
| P4 | 68,000 | 123,000 |
| P5 | 36,000 | 66,000 |
| P6 | 80,000 | 76,000 |
| P7 | 50,000 | 81,000 |
| P8 | 89,000 | 96,000 |

The total budget is 157,000 dollars.
A competitor opened a new site in Marrakech 7 months ago.
Delivery trucks usually arrive around 9:45 in the morning.
Which projects should be funded to maximise the total yearly benefit?
answer_keys: The maximum total yearly benefit in dollars
objective_key: The maximum total yearly benefit in dollars
